metadata.question: Between January 8 and January 15, 2020, did Sistan-Baluchestan experience over 3 inches of rainfall?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about rainfall in Sistan-Baluchestan between January 8-15, 2020, specifically if there was over 3 inches of rainfall. Strategy: 1. Data: Use GPM (Global Precipitation Measurement) IMERG data which provides precipitation measurements 2. Location: Sistan-Baluchestan province in Iran - I'll use FAO GAUL dataset to get the boundary 3. Time: January 8-15, 2020 4. Processing: Sum precipitation over the period and convert from mm to inches (1 inch = 25.4 mm) 5. Validation: Check for data availability and valid pixels I need to: - Get the geometry for Sistan-Baluchestan - Load GPM IMERG precipitation data - Filter by date and location - Sum precipitation over the period - Convert from mm to inches - Check if > 3 inches For data quality: - Check if collection has images - Check if valid pixels exist after processing - Validate the result is reasonable The GPM IMERG data provides precipitation in mm/hour, so I'll need to sum over the time period to get total rainfall. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const provinceName = 'Sistan and Baluchestan'; const startDate = '2020-01-08'; const endDate = '2020-01-15'; // Get Sistan-Baluchestan boundary from FAO GAUL dataset const gaul = ee.FeatureCollection('FAO/GAUL/2015/level1'); const province = gaul.filter(ee.Filter.eq('ADM1_NAME', provinceName)); // 2. Data Acquisition - GPM IMERG precipitation data const gpm = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/GPM_L3/IMERG_V06') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(province); const collectionSize = gpm.size().getInfo(); console.log(`GPM Images: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // Sum precipitation over the period (mm) const totalPrecip = gpm.select('precipitationCal').sum(); // 3. Processing - Check valid pixels const pixelCount = totalPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: province, scale: 10000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitationCal').getInfo(); console.log(`Valid Pixels: ${pixelCount}`); if (pixelCount === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // 4. Calculation - Get mean precipitation and convert to inches const meanPrecip = totalPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: province, scale: 10000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitationCal').getInfo(); const inches = meanPrecip / 25.4; // Convert mm to inches console.log(`Mean Rainfall: ${inches.toFixed(2)} inches`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (meanPrecip === null || !isFinite(meanPrecip) || inches < 0 || inches > 1000) { console.log("C3"); } else if (inches > 3) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
